title: My Daily Routine

instructions.pb-7: 7. Listen to the following sounds and words, then repeat them.
instructions.wb-2: 2. Read, complete with (never/ always) and say.

printed.pb-1: What do you do every day? I ride my bike to the park. I always brush my teeth and wash my hands. I usually tidy my bedroom. I sometimes use my computer. I often read a story with my grandfather. I never stay late at night.
